content.text: Clean on all three. Final visual verification:

All three sizes are rendered and verified. Done.

**Files produced** (in the working folder):
- `square.png` — 1080×1080
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — the source (one file, three layouts via aspect-ratio media queries)

**Design**
- Deep `#0F1226` base with two soft violet radial glows, white text, `#7C5CFF` accent on the role line, avatar ring and the pill button.
- Header: logo mark + `FIELDNOTES CONF 2026` in tracked-out bold, with an accent rule fading to the right edge.
- Portrait is a true circle (`border-radius: 50%` + `object-fit: cover`, framed at 50%/42% so the face sits in the optical center) with a violet ring and halo.
- Inter loaded locally via `@font-face` with a variable weight range, `font-display: block` so nothing renders in a fallback.

**Per-size layout**
- **Square** — vertical stack; avatar sits left of the name/role, title at 58px wraps to 3 lines, date and button on one baseline row.
- **Landscape** — two columns: title (60px, 3 lines) on the left, portrait with name/role centered beneath it on the right. The speaker column is 570px wide so the long hyphenated name holds one line with slack.
- **Story** — single left-aligned column, 368px avatar, 76px title over 4 lines, date stacked above the button.

**Verification** — I ran a Playwright DOM audit at each viewport checking element bounding boxes, document scroll size, and pairwise overlap of the header/speaker/title/footer blocks. All three report no out-of-bounds elements, no overlap, no document overflow, and a perfectly square avatar box. Two defects found and fixed along the way: the name broke across two lines in landscape (widened the column and set `nowrap`), and the square had an unbalanced void under the title (centered the body region in the space between header and footer). The only remaining audit notes were 2px `scrollHeight` line-box rounding on visible, non-clipping text.
